title: Assemble governed Customer Privacy access exports
objective: Implement repository step 10 only: trusted-internal, replay-safe Customer Privacy access/export assembly through customer_privacy.access_export.request@1.0.0 and the exact customer_data.export.privacy.request@1.0.0 owner boundary, persisting only immutable Customer Privacy manifest and stable Customer Data Operations job/artifact references while reusing the existing audited artifact disclosure path.
deliverables: implement the frozen trusted-internal customer_privacy.access_export.request@1.0.0 coordinate with no public ingress or Customer Privacy worker
assemble a deterministic immutable access/export manifest from exact privacy case, scope snapshot, action plan, retention decision and durable owner-outcome lineage
persist a tenant-bound strictly rehydrated Customer Privacy export-reference aggregate before artifact I/O
invoke only customer_data.export.privacy.request@1.0.0 for Customer Data Operations-owned job and artifact creation
reuse the existing immutable file artifact and authenticated audited download boundary without an alternate file endpoint
recover the artifact-finalized before Customer Privacy case-link crash window by reusing the same deterministic target idempotency and artifact identity
preserve FORCE RLS, shared canonical-Party locking, activation gating, exact initiating-capability attribution and safe errors
add permanent Rust, PostgreSQL and process-level acceptance for exact replay, conflicting replay, cross-tenant concealment and bounded non-effects

no public mutation/query coordinate, route, worker, owner outcome v1 schema, destructive owner action, crate, dependency, Cargo.lock or workspace-package change

change the existing Customer Data Operations public Party export contracts

finalize privacy cases or implement convergence verification
add a Customer Privacy worker or generic runtime business switch
